slides.narration: Chapter 14: Time and Its Arrow. The carry cascade moves in one direction — from lower stages to higher stages. This one-way flow is not imposed; it follows from the structure of the cascade itself. And it gives time its arrow.

lines: This is the arrow of time.
slides.narration: Carries propagate upward through the tower, never downward. The past cannot be un-carried. This irreversibility is not a law added on top of the physics — it is built into the tower's arithmetic. The arrow of time is the direction of the carry cascade.
